nodes.name: AttendanceFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Attendance filter request DTO: userId, departmentId, dateFrom, dateTo, status, page, size, sortBy, sortDir. Used for paginated attendance queries.

nodes.name: CompanyTimesheetFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Company timesheet filter request DTO: departmentId, dateFrom, dateTo, status, page, size. HR/admin view for company-wide timesheet reporting.

nodes.name: EditAttendanceRequest.java
nodes.summary: Edit attendance request DTO: attendanceId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, status, note. Used by HR/manager to correct attendance records.

nodes.name: ManagerTimesheetFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Manager timesheet filter request DTO: teamId, dateFrom, dateTo, status, page, size. Manager view for team timesheet approval.

nodes.name: MonthlyTimesheetEditRequest.java
nodes.summary: Monthly timesheet edit request DTO: userId, month, year, dailyRecords (list of day, checkIn, checkOut, status), submittedBy. Bulk monthly correction.

nodes.name: StaffTimesheetFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Staff timesheet filter request DTO: dateFrom, dateTo, status, page, size. Employee self-view for personal timesheet.

nodes.name: CompanyMonthlyTimesheetResponse.java
nodes.summary: Company monthly timesheet response DTO: userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, dailyRecords, totalWorkingHours, totalOvertimeHours, leaveDays. Aggregated for HR reporting.

nodes.name: HrAttendanceResponse.java
nodes.summary: HR attendance response DTO: attendanceId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, checkInTime, checkOutTime, status, location, note. HR view with all fields.

nodes.name: ManagerAttendanceResponse.java
nodes.summary: Manager attendance response DTO: attendanceId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, checkInTime, checkOutTime, status, location. Manager view (subset of HR).

nodes.name: StaffAttendanceResponse.java
nodes.summary: Staff attendance response DTO: attendanceId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, status, location, note. Employee self-view (minimal fields).

nodes.name: StaffMonthlyTimesheetResponse.java
nodes.summary: Staff monthly timesheet response DTO: month, year, dailyRecords, totalWorkingHours, totalOvertimeHours, leaveDays, pendingRequests. Employee self-view summary.

nodes.name: Attendance.java
nodes.summary: Attendance JPA entity: id, userId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, status (PRESENT, ABSENT, LATE, EARLY_LEAVE, ON_LEAVE, REMOTE), location, ipAddress, deviceInfo, note, createdAt, updatedAt. Daily attendance record with geofence/IP validation.

nodes.name: MonthlyTimesheet.java
nodes.summary: MonthlyTimesheet JPA entity: id, userId, month, year, status (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED), totalWorkingHours, totalOvertimeHours, leaveDays, submittedAt, approvedAt, approvedBy. Monthly summary for payroll.

nodes.name: TimesheetStatus.java
nodes.summary: TimesheetStatus enum: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED. Workflow states for monthly timesheet approval process.

nodes.name: AttendanceException.java
nodes.summary: Attendance exception: extends RuntimeException with error codes (ALREADY_CHECKED_IN, NOT_CHECKED_IN, INVALID_LOCATION, OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE, INVALID_TIME, TIMESHEET_LOCKED, INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION). Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: WorkShiftRepository.java
nodes.summary: WorkShift repository: JPA repository for WorkShift entity (defined in asset module). Methods: findByDepartmentId, findActiveByUserId, findByDateRange. Used for shift-based attendance validation.
